recommendation_summary: The reply rejects the APPROVED-column/initials/naming-convention approach. It recommends keeping the folder for drafts and, on approval, saving a frozen copy that authors cannot edit. The approver identity comes from their login and the time from a system clock, approval is refused when the approver is the author or not one of the three reviewers, and the copy and record are kept for seven years. It offers no optional additions and no unmet needs, and closes by asking the user to confirm.
note: The reply recommends a sound enforceable control, but none of the four labelled record lines appear in it, so every label-based check fails.
